user.title: Connect to ista
user.description: Log in with the consumer number (forbrugernummer) and password you use on istaonline.dk.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate ista
reauth_confirm.description: ista rejected the stored login for consumer number {username}. Enter the password again.

abort.already_configured: This ista account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The login belongs to a different ista account. Log in with the account that was originally configured.

init.title: Estimated prices
init.description: Unit prices for the period ista has not settled yet. They are used for days after the newest settled statement until a newer statement arrives. Leave a field empty to keep using the settled price. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.estimate_brugsvand: Price per m³ of cold water, as on the line Brugsvand kubikmeter of the water statement. Also part of the hot water price.
data_description.estimate_varmt_vand: Price per m³ for heating the hot water, as on the line Varmt vand kubikmeter of the heat statement.
data_description.estimate_varme: Price per kWh of heat, as on the line Varme KWh of the heat statement.
